summary: The change removes the audit event for payment memo amendments in LedgerService.amend_memo and replaces it with an application log line, while the memo update is still persisted. That violates AUD-1 (every state-changing operation records an audit event), and no approved exception covers it. CI passes only because the AUD-1 control test is a sample that does not exercise memo edits, and the PR's claim of updated unit tests doesn't match the one-file diff. Process records (ticket, independent approval on head, CI on head) are otherwise in order, but the product violation requires REJECT.
